facts.fact: Lot 20 的手链是 Mimi 在 1969 年买给妹妹 Pamela 的结婚礼物，后来被退了回来。
facts.anchor: Purchased by Mimi in 1969 as a wedding gift for her sister Pamela, and later returned.

facts.fact: Miriam 下火车时，Ma 开口第一句就是审查式问话：就你一个人？你没把他带来吧？
facts.anchor: her first words as I stepped out of the carriage. ‘You haven’t brought him, have you?’

facts.fact: Ma 仍持续给 Miriam 寄纸绳捆扎的包裹：缝纫包、Nana 的拼布被等物件。
facts.anchor: She still sent paper-and-string-wrapped parcels: my sewing kit, Nana’s quilt

facts.fact: Pa 对 Miriam 只客气地说了声下午好，这份紧绷的礼貌确认了父女间的冷淡。
facts.anchor: ‘Good afternoon,’ Pa said, tight politeness confirming this.

facts.fact: Mackie 的热情在当天 Miriam 全家人中极为稀缺，让 Miriam 大大松了口气。
facts.anchor: His warmth – scarce among my family that day – was a huge relief.

facts.fact: 新娘 Pamela 盛装入场，美丽、成熟、优雅，宛如「冬之女王」。
facts.anchor: Gosh, she looked beautiful. Grown-up and elegant. A winter queen.

facts.fact: 新娘的胸部涨了两个三个罩杯、从心形领口鼓起——孕相在婚礼现场暴露。
facts.anchor: Her bust had jumped a cup size or three, swelling over the sweetheart neckline.

facts.fact: Ma 用幅度极小的点头，无声回答了 Miriam 眼神里的提问。
facts.anchor: Her tiniest nod was the answer.
